title: Currywurst German Sausage
description: A classic German street food dish made with grilled sausage, curry ketchup, and crispy onions.
instructions: Grill the Bratwurst sausage over medium heat until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, toast the buns on the grill or in a toaster.
Slice the onion and pepper into thin strips.
Grill the onion and pepper until caramelized, about 3-5 minutes.
Brush the curry ketchup onto the toasted buns.
Slice the grilled sausage and place on top of the buns.
Add the caramelized onion and pepper on top of the sausage.
Sprinkle curry powder and salt to taste.
Garnish with a lime wedge and serve immediately.
